events.title: Peter Beardsley leaves 맨체스터 유나이티드 and returns to Vancouver Whitecaps on a free transfer, having only made one appearance for the Old Trafford club. In the only First Division action of the day, Brighton win 2–1 at Swansea to draw level on points with their opponents in the battle against relegation. Second Division leaders 울버햄프턴 원더러스 at 셰필드 웬즈데이 1–0 at home.

European action resumes with European Cup holders 애스턴 빌라 losing 2–1 at home to 유벤투스 in the quarter-final first leg, while 리버풀's hopes of a fourth European Cup triumph in seven seasons are hit hard when they go down 2–0 to Polish champions Widzew Lodz . However, 밥 페이즐리's team still look assured to retain their league title after their nearest rivals 왓퍼드 and 맨체스터 유나이티드 are both beaten away from home in the First Division, with 왓퍼드 going down 3–0 to 노리치 시티 at Carrow Road and 맨체스터 유나이티드 lose 1–0 away to a 스토크 시티 side who are now pushing for UEFA Cup qualification for the first time in eight years. 에버턴 miss the chance of break into the top five when they are held to a goalless draw by 맨체스터 시티 at Maine Road .

리버풀 continue their surge towards the First Division title with a 5–1 home win over 스토크 시티, although 왓퍼드 keep up the pressure with a 1–0 win at Coventry, as do 맨체스터 유나이티드 who triumph 1–2 in the Manchester derby at Maine Road .
애스턴 빌라 go fourth in the First Division with a 2–0 home win over 노츠 카운티.

아스널 go through to the FA Cup semi-finals with a 2–0 home win over 애스턴 빌라, as do Brighton with a 1–0 home win over 노리치 시티. 맨체스터 유나이티드 are in the semi-finals for the first time in four seasons after beating 에버턴 1–0 at Old Trafford. The fourth quarter-final clash ends in a 1–1 draw between 번리 and 셰필드 웬즈데이 at Turf Moor. Leaders 리버풀 beat 웨스트햄 유나이티드 3–0 in the First Division. In the race for a UEFA Cup place, 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 beat 입스위치 타운 4–1 at home. 맨체스터 시티, who were among the title contenders as recently as November, are now in danger of relegation after going down 4–1 at Swansea, a result which lifts the hosts out of the bottom three. An eight-goal thriller at Vicarage Road sees 왓퍼드 beat 노츠 카운티 5-3.
버밍엄 시티 boost their survival hopes with a 2–1 home win over 아스널. The race for a UEFA Cup place features a 2–0 home win for 에버턴 over 사우샘프턴.
셰필드 웬즈데이 thrash 번리 in the Hillsborough replay 5–0 to reach the FA Cup semi-finals for the first time since 1966.

맨체스터 유나이티드 keep their slim hopes of catching 리버풀 alive by beating 웨스트햄 유나이티드 2–1 at Old Trafford, as do 왓퍼드 with a 2–1 home win over 버밍엄 시티. 리버풀 are held to a 2–2 draw at Brighton. The race for a UEFA Cup place features a 2–2 draw between 아스널 and 입스위치 타운 at Highbury. QPR move closer to ending their four-year exile from the First Division by beating 찰턴 애슬레틱 5–1 at Loftus Road . 레스터 시티's hopes of breaking into the top three are hit when 셰필드 웬즈데이 hold them to a 2–2 draw at Hillsborough.

리버풀 clinch the League Cup for the third season running by beating 맨체스터 유나이티드 2–1 in the final at Wembley. Alan Kennedy and Ronnie Whelan score for 리버풀, and 17-year-old Norman Whiteside becomes the youngest scorer in a major Wembley final for United. On the same day, legendary former 맨체스터 유나이티드 player 조지 베스트 signs for Third Division side 본머스 two months before his 37th birthday.
England are held to a 0–0 draw by Greece at Wembley in a European Championship qualifier.

리버풀 are looking all set to add the league title to their League Cup this season, as they end March as First Division leaders with a 13-point lead over nearest challengers 왓퍼드. 맨체스터 유나이티드, 애스턴 빌라 and 사우샘프턴 complete the top five. The bottom three clubs remain unchanged for the second month-end running. 퀸스 파크 레인저스 have overhauled 울버햄프턴 원더러스 at the top of the Second Division, while 풀럼 remain third but still under pressure from a determined 레스터 시티 side. 더비 카운티 are at last showing some sign of being able to avoid relegation as they are now just two points adrift of safety.
